settings.heading: Time Captured in Scent
settings.subtext: A rare alchemy of ancient woods, sacred resins and the golden hour — distilled into a single breath.

settings.heading: Born from Silence
settings.paragraph_1: Samay was born in the lantern-lit lanes of old Delhi, where a perfumer's notebook and a grandmother's memory became the seed of something rare.
settings.paragraph_2: We source only what the season offers willingly — raw oud from Assam's oldest agarwood groves, Mysore sandalwood aged in silence, Bulgarian rose absolute hand-pressed at dawn.
settings.paragraph_3: Every bottle holds a specific hour — not just a fragrance. An atmosphere you can return to.
settings.milestone_1_text: First batch distilled in a copper athar still

settings.heading: A Living Accord
settings.description: A compound of 1000 g, matured in ethanol and rare musks. Every element chosen for the hour it inhabits.

settings.heading: Sculpted in Darkness
settings.description: An architectural flacon sculpted from heavyweight smoked French glass, crowned with a 24-karat gold-gilded magnetic stopper. Each flacon is individually numbered.
settings.spec_2_val: Solid Zamak alloy, hand-gilded in 24K gold
settings.spec_3_val: 180 days in dark French oak casks

settings.heading: Voices in Reverie
settings.description: Words from collectors, perfumers, and quiet observers who have made Samay their signature hour.
settings.press_quote: A composition that does not merely enter a room — it quietly claims memory itself.
settings.review_1_text: The transition from the crisp bergamot to the smoky birch tar is intoxicating. It lingers on cashmere for days without ever feeling overpowering.
settings.review_2_text: You can taste the authenticity of the Assam agarwood and Mysore sandalwood. Nothing synthetic. A masterclass in restraint and quiet luxury.
settings.review_3_text: Rarely does a contemporary house achieve such timeless gravitas. Samay has bottled the quiet golden hour of twilight.
